description: Get authoritative documentation for a Godot ENGINE class or member, from the exact editor build in use. Returns: signature with argument names, types and defaults, plus documentation. USE THIS instead of recalling Godot's API from memory - it is the ground truth for the user's version and prevents inventing methods that do not exist. Pass 'member' for a specific method/property/signal; omit it to check a class exists.
name: gdscript_engine_api
